scope: Theorem 10.10 (Rational compatibility) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 97. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The generators in (3.3) may be chosen so that α1 = ζ and the actual localization map T → LK(1)T satisfies α3 7−→ cδ, ζα3 7−→ cζδ (c ∈ Q× p ) (10.11) after rationalization. In particular the rational homotopy of T has basis 1, ζ, α3, ζα3, α5, ζα5, α3α5, ζα3α5 in degrees 0, −1, −3, −4, −5, −6, −8, −9, respectively.
